title: Brilliant product and service
body: Firstly this charcoal is the best I've used on my smoker — nice big bits, not grainy and dusty. Secondly the lovely customer service experience was a complete pleasure. I will certainly buy from this company again. Isn't it nice when you're an appreciated customer. Thanks team! X

title: Best charcoal I've ever bought
body: Great vendor to buy from — the charcoal supplied is top quality. Forget garage/supermarket charcoal, this is the stuff you should buy from a proper supplier! I've used it in my kamado and BBQ and it burns for longer with excellent heat! Definitely getting more.

title: Extreme heat and long cooking time
body: Excellent — delivery fast, product is superb, extreme heat and long cooking time. Will always buy your product and will recommend to family and friends. P.S. thanks for the sweets!

title: 3rd order and still the most consistent
body: Brilliant service! Ordered Monday, delivered Wednesday, well packaged and 1st class product. This is my 3rd order from here. I have had charcoal from other suppliers in the past and understand that views are subjective, but have found this to be the most consistent.

title: Quality charcoal with a lovely surprise
body: Quality charcoal, have used many times and will use again. Even received a box of matches, and another small gift (no spoilers) with the order.

title: Excellent service with thoughtful extras
body: Excellent service, quick delivery and well thought out little extras — the fact sheet for starting a fire, the matches and the Haribo. Looking forward to firing up the BBQ. Thank you, Sammy.

title: Perfect for Kamado cooking
body: Great quality charcoal. The seller clearly takes pride in their products. Burns very well and almost certainly fine to cook low and slow on all day in a Kamado without refueling. Will be buying again.

title: Works brilliantly in my Big Green Egg
body: Arrived sooner than expected. They were in a sturdy cardboard box, which helps stop the charcoal getting bashed into small lumps. Came with instructions and disposable gloves — great product and a good price, works well in my Big Green Egg.

title: No smoke — just heat
body: I've had plenty of restaurant grade charcoals over the years but this is brilliant. No smoke but plenty of heat. I'll be ordering again and again.

title: Went above and beyond
body: Perfect seller. All items sent in time and with a personal note, instructions how to best light the coal, some treats and even gloves so I don't get dirty carrying the charcoal. A very nice gesture that really makes a difference. I will definitely buy again.

title: Impressed with the quality
body: This is my second order — I was so impressed with the quality of the first. The lumps are big right down to the bottom of the bag, it lights well, burns well and stays hot. Fast order turnaround and excellent delivery. A very good supplier.

title: Restaurant grade — and it shows
body: Bought the restaurant grade charcoal for my barbecue and I'm very pleased. The chunk size of the lump wood is excellent — just as described!

title: Great lumpwood — lasts well
body: Great lumpwood charcoal, lasts well with good size pieces. Will purchase again.

title: Arrived next day with a gift
body: Quick delivery, good kindling and the Haribo was a pleasant surprise treat.

title: Absolutely amazed by the speed
body: Ordered yesterday afternoon, arrived 9.45 this morning. Doesn't get better than that. I only expected 3 sacks but received 5! Also arrived with a small confectionary gift. The kindling looks perfect — very dry and an ideal size. Will certainly be using this company again.

title: Best kindling I've ever bought
body: Well there is not a lot you can say about kindling fire wood except it is the best I have ever bought — delivered on time, very well packaged, and good value for money. Will re-order from Xylo UK again. Very pleased, thank you.

title: Second time purchasing
body: Second time purchasing kindling from this seller — amazingly quick delivery and the wood is amazing, perfect size and properly dry so it lights super quick. Will continue to order. Free delivery for an item over 15kg is fantastic. Thank you.

title: Kindling contained in easy-to-handle sacks
body: Service was fast and efficient. Arrived neatly packaged in a box. Kindling contained in 6 easy to handle netted sacks. Excellent kindling for an open fire or stove. Highly recommended A+.

title: With a personal note from Sammy
body: Arrived on time, very well packaged, personal message and gift from Sammy which was a very nice touch. All round excellent product and service.

title: Excellent service from a British producer
body: Excellent service. Very good quality charcoal and good to buy from a British producer.

title: Said what they did. Did what they said.
body: Said what they did. Did what they said. Refreshing change! Good seller.

title: Consistently good and fairly priced
body: Consistently good product at a fair price and always delivered promptly. What more could one ask for?

title: Well packaged and delivered swiftly
body: The charcoal was well packaged, as described and delivered swiftly. Can't ask for more.

title: Highly recommended
body: I have used this company several times now and they have not let me down.

title: Have bought multiple times
body: Have bought multiple times — good price and excellent delivery.

title: Great seller — product is perfect
body: Great seller, highly recommend and product is perfect.

title: Very dry and lights super quick
body: Very good kindling, dry and burns well. Would recommend.

title: Awesome — a note and a treat from Sammy
body: Awesome service from this company. When I opened my order there was a note and a treat from Sammy which made me smile. Thanks again, I really appreciate it.

title: The little touches that make you remember
body: Omg will def use again. They even supplied the matches and gave us sweets to say thank you for the order! It's the little touches like these that will make us remember and use again. I wish them every success.

title: Arrived ahead of schedule with a treat
body: Great wood at a good price and all delivered ahead of schedule. Also (spoiler alert) the little treat in the box was very much appreciated and enjoyed :) THANKYOU
